summary: Simpple Ltd., a Singapore-domiciled foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K disclosing a routine auditor change: on September 22, 2026 the Audit Committee approved dismissal of Audit Alliance LLP and engaged TQ International, PLLC of Flower Mound, Texas, effective immediately. Prior audit reports for fiscal 2025 and 2024 contained no adverse opinion, disclaimer, or qualification, and no disagreements or reportable events under Item 16F(a)(1)(v) are disclosed. Audit Alliance furnished a customary Exhibit 16.1 letter to the SEC. No transaction, shareholder, or capital-structure event; no deal terms apply.
